CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.label: Standard Sea Transit via CFS to Cold Storage (Most Common)
CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.description: Discharged at Nhava Sheva -> shifted to CFS for customs -> trailer road dispatch -> delivered at cold store in sound condition -> damage noticed on destuffing.
CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.template: It was reported to us that after landing from the vessel "[VESSEL NAME]" Voy No. [VOYAGE NO.] at Nhava Sheva Port, India on [DISCHARGE DATE], the subject 40'RH Reefer Container No. [CONTAINER NO.] carrying the subject cargo was shifted to the nominated Container Freight Station (CFS), for customs formalities and delivery. On completion of customs formalities, the subject container was loaded onto the trailer truck, dispatched, road transported and was delivered at the Consignees Cold Storage [COLD STORAGE NAME & ADDRESS], on [DELIVERY DATE], in an externally sound condition. We were further given to understand that during destuffing and checking, the Consignees' warehouse personnel found {COMMODITY} fruits in damaged condition with weight shortage noticed in boxes. Hence, we were contacted and requested to conduct the survey.

CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.label: Container Destuffed & Released Early (To Avoid Detention)
CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.description: Cargo destuffed into cold storage and container immediately released back to shipping line to avoid heavy detention charges.
CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.template: We were apprised that subsequent to its discharge from the vessel "[VESSEL NAME]" Voy No. [VOYAGE NO.] at Nhava Sheva Port, India on [DISCHARGE DATE], the 40' Reefer container No. [CONTAINER NO.], conveying the subject {COMMODITY} cargo, was transferred to the designated Container Freight Station (CFS) for customs formalities. Following the culmination of customs procedures, the container was dispatched via trailer to the Consignees' cold storage facility. Upon arrival, the cargo was immediately destuffed into the cold room and the container was released back to the shipping line to avoid detention charges. During destuffing and stacking, cartons were noted in damaged condition, whereupon survey instructions were issued.

CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.label: Direct CFS Yard On-Wheel Inspection
CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.description: Inspection attended directly at the CFS yard during destuffing before domestic road transit.
CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.template: The subject 40' reefer container No. [CONTAINER NO.] carrying {COMMODITY} fruits was discharged from the carrying vessel at Nhava Sheva Port on [DISCHARGE DATE] and transferred to the nominated Container Freight Station (CFS) under customs bond. At the instruction of the Consignees and Insurers, we attended directly at the CFS yard on [SURVEY DATE] to conduct an on-wheel inspection and witness container destuffing in the presence of attending representatives prior to domestic clearance.

CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.label: Air Freight Consignment via Airport Cargo Terminal
CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.description: Airport cargo terminal arrival -> customs clearance -> refrigerated van transit -> cold room inspection.
CIRCUMSTANCES_OF_LOSS.template: The consignment of fresh {COMMODITY} fruits arrived at the Air Cargo Complex, Mumbai on [ARRIVAL DATE] via flight [FLIGHT NO.] under Air Waybill [AWB NO.]. Following completion of customs clearance and import formalities, the pallets were transferred via refrigerated van to the consignee's cold storage facility. Upon unpalletizing and checking of cartons, decay and softening were observed, prompting survey appointment.

NOTE.label: Container Released Prior to Survey (Avoid Detention)
NOTE.description: Container was already returned to shipping line to avoid detention charges; container settings could not be verified.
NOTE.template: NOTE: Upon our arrival, we observed that the container was no longer available on site. The Consignees informed us that the container had been destuffed and released back to the shipping line to avoid detention charges. As a result, container settings, air delivery chute condition, and initial door-opening stowage could not be physically verified by the attending surveyor.

NOTE.label: Container Inspected On-Site (Seal Verified Intact)
NOTE.description: Container inspected on site prior to door opening; bolt seal verified intact and cut in surveyor's presence.
NOTE.template: NOTE: The subject container was inspected on site prior to destuffing. The external panels, doors, reefer machinery, and gasket seals were found in sound condition with no signs of external physical impact or daylight penetration. The shipping line bolt seal [SEAL NO.] was verified intact against the Bill of Lading and was cut in the presence of all attending representatives.

NOTE.label: Inspection Restricted to Cold Room Pallets
NOTE.description: Cargo was already destuffed into cold storage; inspection restricted to pallets produced by consignee.
NOTE.template: NOTE: The subject cargo had been destuffed into cold storage room no. [ROOM NO.] prior to our inspection. Our survey was accordingly restricted to the boxes and pallets produced before us by the consignees inside the cold storage facility.

SURVEY_FINDINGS.label: Comprehensive Protocol (Pulp Temp + Penetrometer + Brix + Cutting)
SURVEY_FINDINGS.description: Detailed sampling across counts with digital probe temp, penetrometer firmness, sugar brix, cutting condition, and defect sorting.
SURVEY_FINDINGS.template:
From different locations and tiers within the cold room, representative boxes across all available counts were randomly selected and opened for detailed joint examination.

• The pulp temperature of the fresh {COMMODITY} fruits was checked by means of a calibrated digital probe thermometer inside the cold room and was recorded in the range of [MIN_TEMP]°C to [MAX_TEMP]°C. (See Survey Photographs)
• The fruit pressure / firmness was measured using a penetrometer across randomly sampled sound fruits, recording values in the range of [MIN_LBS] to [MAX_LBS] LBS.
• Sugar brix content was measured using an optical/digital refractometer and was found in the range of [MIN_BRIX]% to [MAX_BRIX]%.
• Fruit cutting inspection: Sound fruits exhibited firm, clean pulp with normal seed cavity development. Affected fruits exhibited softening, internal browning, water-soaked pulp, and fungal decay in varying degrees.

The detailed classification of fruits segregated by condition is tabulated below.

SURVEY_FINDINGS.label: Pulp Temperature & 100% Defect Sorting Protocol
SURVEY_FINDINGS.description: Pulp temperature checking and fruit-by-fruit sorting into sound, soft, bruised, and rotten categories.
SURVEY_FINDINGS.template:
Randomly selected cartons from different pallet positions and heights were opened for fruit-by-fruit inspection and condition segregation.

• Pulp temperature was checked inside the cartons using a digital thermometer and registered between [MIN_TEMP]°C and [MAX_TEMP]°C.
• The cold room display temperature was verified and found maintained at [COLD_ROOM_TEMP]°C.
• Fruits inside the sampled cartons were sorted into Sound, Bruised, Soft, Russet, and Rotten categories in accordance with standard trade practices.

The findings across sampled cartons are set out in the table below.

SURVEY_FINDINGS.label: Internal Quality & Flesh Cutting Protocol
SURVEY_FINDINGS.description: Focus on cutting examination, skin defects, and flesh integrity.
SURVEY_FINDINGS.template:
Representative boxes were opened in the presence of attending representatives for external examination and destructive cutting tests.

• Pulp temperature was measured at [MIN_TEMP]°C to [MAX_TEMP]°C across sampled cartons.
• Upon transverse and longitudinal sectioning of sampled fruits, sound units showed clean, crisp pulp structure. Defective fruits exhibited bitter pit marks, sub-epidermal browning, flesh translucency, and soft fungal rot.
• External defects observed included mechanical grading abrasions, limb rubs, and pressure bruising consistent with packing line operations.

APPLICATION.label: Consignee Cold Storage Joint Survey Request
APPLICATION.description: Telephonic survey request and joint inspection at consignee's cold storage facility.
APPLICATION.template:
At the Consignee's survey request and pursuant to appointment given, we attended at Consignees Cold Storage facility — [COLD STORAGE NAME & FULL ADDRESS], on [SURVEY DATE], to conduct a joint survey on the subject consignment of {COMMODITY} fruits.

The survey was conducted jointly in the presence of the attending representatives listed in the attendance register.

APPLICATION.label: CFS Yard Destuffing Survey Request
APPLICATION.description: Formal survey instruction to attend container destuffing at the Container Freight Station.
APPLICATION.template: Pursuant to survey instructions received from the Consignees / Underwriters to inspect the subject containerized consignment of {COMMODITY} fruits, we attended at the nominated Container Freight Station (CFS) yard, Nhava Sheva on [SURVEY DATE], to carry out a joint destuffing inspection.

DOCUMENTATION.label: Standard Marine Cargo Documentation Schedule
DOCUMENTATION.description: Complete annexure list: B/L, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Logger report, Photo Plate, Phytosanitary Certificate.
DOCUMENTATION.template:
Documentation secured and reviewed during our enquiries and site attendance includes:
1. Ocean Bill of Lading
2. Commercial Invoice & Packing List
3. Portable Temperature Recorder (Data Logger) Graph and Tabular Download Report
4. Container Equipment Interchange Receipt (EIR) / Port Gate In-Out Slips
5. Cold Storage Inward Goods Receipt / Weighment Slip
6. Phytosanitary Certificate & Certificate of Origin
7. Comprehensive Survey Photographs Plate (attached hereto)
